title: Manufacturing version 27: use Gitlens & Github BC code history to detect the code differences

Microsoft Dynamics Business Central YouTube channel and manufacturing analytics video

features.name: Manufacturing reporting changes in BC 2025 Wave 2
features.description: Significant changes to reports included with the manufacturing module, including word layouts, Excel layouts, some obsoletions, and documentation updates for in-line and Microsoft Learn documentation.

features.name: Production Order Work in Progress report
features.description: A report showing production order work in progress, mentioned as part of the new analytics in manufacturing.
caveats: Available as both PowerBI report and AL report

features.name: Production Order Statistics report
features.description: A report for production order statistics.

features.name: Production Order List report
features.description: A new report for production orders.

features.name: Stefan Maron BC code history repository
features.description: A GitHub repository maintained by MVP Stefan Maron that contains Business Central source code per version and per country, allowing developers to see what has changed between versions.
caveats: Available for multiple countries (CZ, DK, etc.) and W1 world one

features.name: GitLens Visual Studio Code extension
features.description: A Visual Studio Code extension that enables developers to view file history and compare changes between versions in the BC code repository.
caveats: Must be installed from extensions menu
Provides file history and diff capabilities

features.name: RDLC layout removal and Excel layout default
features.description: Microsoft removed the default RDLC layout in reports and made Excel the default layout for version 27. The RDLC layout is marked as obsolete.
caveats: RDLC layout may still appear if Business Central installation is not clean
Browser report viewer is no longer available by default
Excel layout becomes the only option

features.name: Report data export to data set only
features.description: Users can send report data to get only the data set without layout rendering by using the Send To option.

features.name: Manufacturing analytics site
features.description: A manufacturing analytics site showing personas (staff, management, leadership) and reports useful for each type of user, with resources worked on by Kenny's team.

features.name: Ad hoc analysis on manufacturing ledger pages
features.description: Users can perform ad hoc analysis on manufacturing data on ledger list pages, with the ability to turn analysis on for specific data sets like item ledger entries.

features.name: Open in Excel from list pages
features.description: List pages support opening data directly in Excel for further analysis and manipulation.
